description: Actual Lightroom versus Phosdeck v4 ordinary TIFF16 output; stored RGB16 errors in code16/257, with separately reported ICC-normalized errors.

lightroom.sRGB_target: direct sRGB TIFF16, uncompressed; no resizing, sharpening, HDR, watermark, auto preset or postprocessing
lightroom.prophoto_target: separate calibration target; ICC gamma 1.80078125, never mixed with direct sRGB results

samples.name: c-rgb16-patches.tif
samples.role: existing regression; not independent blind validation

samples.role: existing regression; not independent blind validation

samples.name: k-cc0-canon-raster.tif
samples.role: existing regression; not independent blind validation

samples.name: m-independent-colour-r31.tif
samples.role: captured independently of calibration; used in validation and no longer blind

limits.local_regressions: actual J/K 16 matched pairs include small >0.1-code increases, none >1; unfitted +0.13 SDK prediction has J29/M10 components with increase>1, before is offline not old actual app
limits.JPEG: r30 L zero max4, +2.75 max34.57977, +5 max74.25292; no new JPEG claims from TIFF r31
